fields.bls_release_date: Actual archived BLS CPI announcement date
fields.bls_release_time_et: Authoritative embargo release time when present
fields.computed_yoy_from_same_vintage: Unrounded YoY from levels available in the same BLS information state
fields.cpi_all_items_nsa_level_as_published: CPI-U All Items NSA level in the archived release
fields.point_in_time_safe: Whether archived release evidence establishes the information state
fields.published_yoy_source: Direct archived release row or explicitly labeled published-precision reconstruction from official final CPI-U NSA levels when the legacy release payload could not be rendered
fields.signal_regime: Mechanical low/medium/high label from the preferred published BLS rate
fields.source_effective_after_close_date: Next SPY/NYSE session after announcement; not an executed trade date
fields.source_reconciliation_status: Published versus computed YoY reconciliation classification

missing_data_contract: No forward fill, interpolation, or synthetic release; official nonpublication remains an explicit gap.
